req.title: Task ids are monotonically increasing
req.statement: The system shall assign strictly increasing integer ids to newly created tasks.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that task ids must be strictly increasing integers. To verify this, we need: (1) a positive test confirming two sequential tasks have strictly increasing ids, (2) a boundary test confirming the id of the second task is exactly id_first + 1 (not +2 or equal), and (3) a negative/state-transition test confirming that after creating N tasks the ids form a strictly monotonic sequence with no gaps or reversals. We also add a test that verifies the first task created gets a positive integer id (>= 1), and one that checks three tasks in sequence to catch off-by-one mutations on the increment logic. Each test uses an in-memory SQLite DB via dependency override to remain isolated and idempotent.

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_two_sequential_tasks_have_strictly_increasing_ids():
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task A", "completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task B", "completed": False})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(id1, int)
    assert isinstance(id2, int)
    assert id2 > id1
    assert id2 == id1 + 1

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_test3 = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal3 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test3)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test3)

def override_get_db3():
    db = TestingSessionLocal3()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db3
client3 = TestClient(app)

def test_three_sequential_tasks_form_strictly_monotonic_sequence():
    r1 = client3.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Alpha", "completed": False})
    r2 = client3.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Beta", "completed": False})
    r3 = client3.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Gamma", "completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    assert r3.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    id3 = r3.json()["id"]
    assert id1 < id2
    assert id2 < id3
    assert id2 == id1 + 1
    assert id3 == id2 + 1
    assert id3 == id1 + 2

def test_ids_not_equal_and_not_decreasing():

from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

    try:

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db5
client5 = TestClient(app)

def test_id_increment_is_exactly_one_not_two_or_zero():
    r1 = client5.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Low", "completed": False})
    r2 = client5.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary High", "completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    delta = id2 - id1
    assert delta == 1
    assert delta != 0
    assert delta != 2
    assert delta > 0
